name: SUMO (upper taxonomy)
description: The upper structural spine of the Suggested Upper Merged Ontology — 43 subsumptions over 26 classes (depth ≤ 2 from Entity), translated from docs/references/SUMO1.2.txt. SUMO's top is Sowa's upper ontology, itself built on Peirce's three categories: Independent / Relative / Mediating = Firstness / Secondness / Thirdness.
